notes: SPECIES MISLABELLING IN PEPlife2. All five records for this PMID are filed as 'Wistar rats plasma', but the body assigns only two of them to rats. The rat study is 4 mg/kg IV and SC, giving 3.59 and 3.75 days (PEPlife2 IDs 5299, 5300). The 5.58 d and 7.06 d values are the MOUSE study at 6 mg/kg (IDs 5301, 5302), and '4.59 - 7.06 days' is the range across the MOUSE subcutaneous dose escalation at 1, 6 and 30 mg/kg (ID 5303). IDs 5301 and 5302 have been reassigned to mouse via CURATED_SPECIES, and 5303 has been dropped via CURATED_DUPLICATES because it is a range whose upper bound is already recorded as 5302 and whose midpoint is a number the paper never states. Left uncorrected this study would have contributed three mouse half-lives to the rat cohort, all at the long end of the distribution. The discussion's summary - 'a terminal half-life of 7 and 3.75 days in mice and rats, respectively, after subcutaneous administration' - confirms the assignment independently.
